resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe a 10-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab; Forest Lookouts describes a 10-foot log crib with an L-4 cab. Both are reported in the story; we did not pick one.
Idaho Fire Lookouts lists Julie and James Dobbs under 2012, which cannot match a tower destroyed in 1978. Those names are left out of the story.
The NHLR tower called Horse Mountain Lookout (US 1434, Adams County, built 1935) is a different structure from this Valley County tower destroyed in 1978. Dates are not merged; the story says so.

notes_for_editor: Construction (1934) and destruction (1978) agree across the three Valley County pages. The 10-foot figure may describe the pole or crib rather than the whole tower, so height_m 3.0 is approximate. Staffing rests on one Krause entry (1956). Sister page us-id-horse-mountain-2.md covers the Adams County tower (US 1434, built 1935) and should not be merged with this one; its staffing names (1939, 1981) do not overlap the Valley County entries. No photos checked. Brief record has no errors found.
